title: Public docs and changelog
points: Added this docs page explaining the data pipeline and query engine, plus a public changelog.

Each pipeline step is shown with the real artifact it produces — a filing page next to its OCR markdown, page review records, the statement page map, a QC failure report — and the query engine is traced through a real question.
A Docs button in the app header now links here, with the docs and public changelog generated from repo-owned source files.
